reference.use: Visual reference only. No embedded, traced or extracted reference pixels.
reference.measurementMethod: Approximate manual inspection of the full supplied photograph; not pixel-exact segmentation.
reference.reduceEvidence: No independently legible reduce state in the supplied photograph. The paired inward-corner glyph is an original functional counterpart, subject to actual consumer qualification.

authorship.method: Original hand-authored, editable SVG path geometry, using the supplied reference for proportions and palette direction.
authorship.referenceRights: User-supplied reference; no claim of ownership or redistribution rights in its photograph, branding or characters.
authorship.outputRights: New generic geometric control glyphs contributed to this repository. No additional third-party asset license is required; no trademark clearance is asserted.

embedding.mode: Standalone img; no external SVG use or font dependency.
controlOwnerResponsibilities: at least 44 by 44 CSS pixel target
embedding.surfaces: Cream ink requires a dark ink or red titlebar surface. Do not place these files directly on a cream surface or recolor through a destructive whole-image filter.
embedding.stars: Decorative strip only; no rating, count or clickable state. Start at 72 by 24 CSS pixels at a 390px viewport; confirm actual 360/390/430 frame fit.
embedding.controls: Start at 24 by 24 CSS pixels centered in the consumer's native >=44px target; reference-proportional reductions must retain legible ink. The SVG contains no hit target or button face.
